detail.title: Intex FA10MBGL 10KG Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine (Metal Body)
detail.overview: Upgrade your laundry experience with the Intex FA10MBGL 10KG Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine. Designed with a durable metal body and a spacious 10KG capacity, it is ideal for medium to large families. Powered by intelligent Fuzzy Logic Technology, the machine automatically optimizes the wash cycle for superior cleaning while saving water and energy. The 700 RPM spin speed ensures faster drying, while the stainless steel inner drum provides long-lasting performance and gentle fabric care. Equipped with features like Auto Imbalance Detection & Correction, Delay Wash, Low Water Pressure Operation, Air Drying, and End Program Buzzer, this washing machine delivers effortless, efficient, and reliable washing every day.
